name: ACCA Applied Knowledge: Business and Technology, Management Accounting, Financial Accounting (BT/FBT, MA/FMA, FA/FFA)
material_vintage: ACCA's syllabus and study guides for the three Applied Knowledge papers - Business and Technology (BT/FBT), Management Accounting (MA/FMA) and Financial Accounting (FA/FFA) - Session 2025-2026 (S25-A26) editions, fetched live from accaglobal.com on 2026-09-27 and itemised in full against ACCA's own syllabus heading letters and numbers (BT.A1-BT.F4; MA.A1-MA.F4; FA.A1-FA.I3). Exam format: each paper is a 2-hour computer-based exam (CBE), objective-test only - BT/FBT: Section A 46 objective questions (30 x 2 marks + 16 x 1 mark) + Section B 6 x 4-mark multi-task questions (one per syllabus section A-F), 100 marks; MA/FMA: the same CBE objective-test structure, 100 marks; FA/FFA: Section A 35 x 2-mark objective questions + Section B 2 x 15-mark multi-task questions (consolidations and accounts preparation), 100 marks. ACCA publishes a single, fixed pass mark of 50% for every exam, applied per paper as well as overall. Every numeric worked example (cost accounting, budgeting, variances, depreciation, double-entry, ratios, basic consolidation) was computed live with Python, so it is correct by construction; the tutor should still check current live data (tax rates, interest rates) is not needed here, since accounting mechanics rather than jurisdiction-specific rates are examined at this level.
level_source: standalone: a professional accounting body qualification with no RQF/FHEQ level

learner_notices.text: ACCA's real BT/FBT exam is 100% objective-test (single-select, multiple-response, multi-task/matching, no free-text questions). Some of this course's Business and Technology stage-test items use an 'Explain...'/'Outline...' short-answer format instead, as a deeper comprehension check on qualitative topics (e.g. leadership vs management, ethical threats) -- these build understanding but are not a format simulation of the real CBE. The course's cumulative exam uses genuine objective-test items throughout, matching ACCA's real format.
